Introduction

Lee Siyeon is a South Korean singer and guitarist under 3Y CORPORATION and Tamago Production. She is best known as the main vocalist and guitarist of the project girl band QWER. She is also known as the first pure foreign idol to debut as a member of NMB48 in Japan.

On August 25, 2023, Siyeon was confirmed as a member of the upcoming female band QWER. She made her debut with the band on October 18, 2023, with the release of their debut single album, "Harmony from Discord".
